title: Manuscrito de Chichicastenango (Popol buj)

contributors.name: J. Antonio Villacorta C. (José Antonio Villacorta Calderón)

notes: Guatemala: Sánchez & de Guise, 1927; 416 pages in Google Books record. K’iche’ and Spanish on facing pages.
Do not confuse with the separate 1927 Asturias/González de Mendoza Spanish translation of Raynaud or the 1934 Villacorta/Rodas printing.
Smithsonian catalog confirms year and contributors; full-text scan not obtained. Seek library digitization or another original 1927 copy.
